main.description: Trails and roads, and segment groups on none (segments/segment-paths), found by name: a path whose name, or one of whose segments' current names, contains q, ignoring case, and a segment group on no path with a segment named so. Counts only segments the viewer could get from a segment search, never lifts, so a path with none is left out. Each result is ranked by its best match: the whole name, then a name starting with q, then a word starting with q, then the rest; within a match nearest the given centre first, else by name. limit and cursor count results.

q.description: Search text, case-insensitive. A blank query returns no results.

minLat.description: 1e-7 degrees. The box is optional, but all four of its sides or none: only results with a counted segment whose line passes through it.

nearLat.description: 1e-7 degrees. The centre results are ordered from within a match, with nearLng or not at all.

sport.description: Count only segments of this sport group.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Only some of the box's sides, or only one of nearLat and nearLng; a box with min above max, or wider than 1 degree on either side.

result.description: One result: a path, or the counted segments of a segment group on no path. Exactly one of path and group.

group.description: Every segment of the group the search counts, matching or not.
